reviews.shade: SKIN FOOD Rice Daily Brightening Mask Wash Off 210g
reviews.text:
The smell is really nice and gives me a kind of luxury spa feeling. The texture has a mild scrub, but it’s very gentle on the skin, even if your skin is sensitive.
After rinsing it off with water, my face felt soft and refreshed, and I noticed a little brightening effect right away. Since I’ve only used it once so far, I’m excited to keep using it and see more results.
reviews.zh:
氣味真係好正，俾人一種高級 spa 嘅感覺。質地帶有溫和嘅磨砂，但好溫和，敏感肌都啱用。
沖水之後，成塊面覺得軟熟又清爽，而且即時見到少少提亮效果。目前只係用過一次，好期待繼續用落去睇下仲有咩效果。

reviews.shade: SKIN FOOD Rice Daily Brightening Mask Wash Off 210g
reviews.text: The scrub feels really nice, with delicate fine grains and an amazing scent. It’s a bit drying, but I still highly recommend it... You can also use it as a face mask
reviews.zh: 磨砂嘅觸感好舒服，磨砂粒子細緻，香味亦都好讚。用完會有少少乾，但我仍然非常推薦⋯⋯仲可以當面膜用。

reviews.shade: SKIN FOOD Rice Daily Brightening Mask Wash Off 210g
reviews.text: No lo he usado mucho porque tengo piel sensible, creo que me funciona usarlo dos o treces veces x semana aunque a veces lo olvido, pero es muy buen producto
reviews.zh: 因為我係敏感肌，所以用得唔算密，大概一個星期用兩三次左右，雖然有時會唔記得，但係都覺得呢個產品幾好。

reviews.shade: SKIN FOOD Rice Daily Brightening Mask Wash Off 210g
reviews.text: The mask has a soft, mud-like texture with small exfoliating beads that don’t cause any discomfort. I decided to try it after seeing good reviews and visible results. If it suits my skin, I’ll continue to repurchase in the long run
reviews.zh: 面膜質地柔軟，類似泥狀，內含細小磨砂粒子，但用落完全唔會造成任何不適。我係睇到好嘅評價同明顯嘅效果之後先試吓。如果啱我膚質，長遠嚟講我會持續回購。

reviews.shade: SKIN FOOD Rice Daily Brightening Mask Wash Off 210g
reviews.text:
I just tried this mask yesterday and honestly, I’m impressed! The smell is really nice and gives me a kind of luxury spa feeling. The texture has a mild scrub, but it’s very gentle on the skin, even if your skin is sensitive.
After rinsing it off with water, my face felt soft and refreshed, and I noticed a little brightening effect right away. Since I’ve only used it once so far, I’m excited to keep using it and see more results.
reviews.zh:
我尋日先用咗呢款面膜，老實講，我覺得好驚喜！味道好聞，畀我一種奢華 spa 嘅感覺。質地帶有輕微磨砂，但對皮膚非常溫和，就算係敏感肌都冇問題。
用清水沖走之後，成塊面感覺柔軟清爽，而且我即刻就見到少少提亮效果。因為暫時只係用過一次，我好期待繼續用落去睇下仲有咩效果。

reviews.shade: SKIN FOOD Rice Daily Brightening Mask Wash Off 210g
reviews.text:
I've been using the SKINFOOD Rice Daily Brightening Mask Wash Off for a month, and I love how it makes my skin feel. The texture is gentle and creamy, and it has a mild, pleasant scent. After using it, my skin looks noticeably brighter and feels incredibly soft and smooth. It's become a staple in my skincare routine for its brightening and exfoliating benefits. 

Highly recommend for anyone looking to add a gentle yet effective mask to their regimen!
reviews.zh:
我用 SKINFOOD Rice Daily Brightening Mask Wash Off 已經一個月，好鍾意用完之後嘅膚觸。質地溫和而且 creamy，帶有淡淡嘅舒服香味。用完之後，膚色明顯提亮，皮膚變得超級柔軟嫩滑。憑住佢嘅提亮同去角質功效，已經成為我護膚流程中嘅必備品。

強烈推薦畀想喺護膚程序中加入一款溫和但有效嘅面膜嘅人！

reviews.shade: SKIN FOOD Rice Daily Brightening Mask Wash Off 210g
reviews.text: really good! i love rice as a skincare ingredient and as someone with sensitive skin this doesn't dry my skin out. i don't use it daily, i use this every three days.
reviews.zh: 真係好好用！我本身就鍾意用米做護膚成分，而我又係敏感肌，呢款完全唔會抽乾我塊面。我唔係日日用，大約三至四天先至用一次。

reviews.shade: SKIN FOOD Rice Daily Brightening Mask Wash Off 210g
reviews.text: Immediately I noticed my skin brighten right after washing this off. However, there is a bit of rice residue that is a little scratchy and takes a little more washing to get off. I found that it's easier if I do this mask before showers and then with the power of the shower I am more easily able to wash off the whole mask without residue unlike using a sink.
reviews.zh: 我即刻就發現用完沖走之後皮膚提亮咗。不過，有少少米粒殘留物，質感有少少刮面，要沖多幾次水先洗得乾淨。我發現喺沖涼之前用呢款面膜會方便啲，借助沖涼嘅水力就可以更輕鬆咁沖走成塊面膜，唔會有殘留，反而用洗手盆就冇咁容易。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
